purpose: Illustrated warmup and objectives for Τα βατράχια του Άρη
layout: 2x2 equal-square atlas. Top-left collect; top-right fight; bottom-left sabotage; bottom-right defend. CSS windows select each picture without editing the original bitmap.
prompt: Create a premium finished video-game tutorial artwork atlas: one square image divided into an EXACT 2 by 2 grid of four equal square illustrated scenes, NO gutters, NO frames, NO lettering, NO numbers, NO words anywhere. Cohesive charming polished 3D-rendered frog action game, lush creek pond, speckled wet frogs, big golden eyes and broad smiles, mint green and warm gold light, tactile details, beautiful highly legible small-format compositions. Each scene must be self-contained inside its own square. Upper-left square: a bright green speckled frog catching a single clearly visible fly with its long extended pink tongue beside reeds, showing collecting flies as ammunition. Upper-right square: green frog spitting a visible little fly projectile toward a coral orange rival frog with comically dizzy golden stars over its head; playful nonviolent cartoon battle, no weapons. Lower-left square: green frog INSIDE the open doorway of a small detailed red-roofed wooden enemy hut with fly storage baskets, pulling apart the hut's fly storage, clearly sabotage the enemy storehouse; NO fire, NO explosives, NO axe, NO tools. Lower-right square: green frog confidently guarding its own green-roofed wooden creek hut, with a full basket of flies visible by its doorway, protective posture looking outward, warm inviting little home. Consistent character design, actual realistic webbed frog hands and toes, no clothing, no humanoid body. Clear main silhouettes, rich painted 3D game art, neither flat icons nor emoji nor schematic shapes. The four full square paintings must meet at the exact horizontal and vertical center so a UI can display each quarter as a separate picture. This is an art atlas asset, not a UI screenshot. No extra fifth scene.
wordmark: Editable Greek type over existing menu-plaque-v1.png; local breathing letter shapes, blinking decorative eyes and forming/bursting dew. Existing articulated frog sprites are unchanged.
fidelity: Instructional illustrations match the game's actions and character palette. They are illustrations, not gameplay screenshots or exact reconstructions of the imported house mesh.
